Previously suggested, unvalidated automatic links may be recalculated. Manual links and validated matches will be preserved.

Remove only the selected image lines from their existing alignment groups.
Link selected lines; when one line is already linked, extend its existing group with missing lines (Ctrl+Enter).

These lines already belong to this correspondence; no change is necessary.
Existing group extended: {reference} line(s) added in the first witness and {target} in the second. Uncertain automatic matches remain uncertain after correction.

None of the selected lines belongs to an alignment.
First select the group(s) to delete from the list below the images.
Delete the {count} selected group(s) entirely? All their lines will become unlinked.

Select the lines to unlink directly on the images.
Exclude or restore ALTO lines across the project without altering source files.
Select manuscript lines to ignore or restore.

Text scope changed: {count} line(s). Save the .vsynch project.

Restore ignored lines before linking them.

No sufficiently reliable extension found. If the missing line belongs to a validated group, use “Link selected lines” to correct it manually.
All extensions remain uncertain. Only unvalidated machine-generated groups can be extended. Manual and validated groups are not modified. HTR is optional.

Diagnostic: {protected} lines near protected groups, {ambiguous} ambiguous cases, {both} lines with possible free matches on both sides, {no_neighbour} with no nearby group, {capped} suggestions capped, {unreliable} geometrically uncertain cases.
Add A [{left}] / B [{right}] to group A [{old_left}] ↔ B [{old_right}]

Here you can reorder images, associate them with their ALTO/PAGE segmentation, define where the passage you wish to study begins and ends on a page (the physical scope), and link a TEI XML edition to the image lines of a witness.
Manage images, their order and ALTO/PAGE associations…
Drag pages into reading order. You can also use Move up, Move down or Reverse order. Thumbnails are loaded as needed.
Reading order is independent of image ↔ ALTO/PAGE bindings: moving a page never changes its image, XML source or line IDs. Remember to save the .vsynch project.
{assigned}/{total} pages bound to XML · Save changes in the .vsynch project
Select exactly one page to use these buttons. To move multiple pages, drag them in the list.
Select one or more lines in exactly one witness. An absence means that their passage is missing in the other witness of this pair.

Confirm that {count} line(s) in {witness} have no textual counterpart in {missing}? {affected} uncertain automatic group(s) will be adjusted; {groups} absence group(s) will be created. Manual and validated links remain unchanged.
Absence confirmed: {count} line(s), no counterpart in {missing}.
Remove selected absences from review list
Select one or more absence groups in the review queue (Absences filter).
Selection includes a correspondence: only absence groups can be removed using this command.
Remove {count} confirmed absence group(s)? Their lines will become unlinked and available for correspondence again.
{count} absence group(s) removed; the lines are available again.
Detailed report shown in “4 · Finalize”. No files or associations were changed.

No witness alignment has been saved yet.

Choose where to save the new project
Choose a different location: this file belongs to the currently open project.

Use this witness as the pivot for aligning witnesses
This resource is already part of the project. It cannot be removed here because existing alignments may depend on it.

{total} unlinked page(s); {ordinal} proposal(s) based on natural order alone.
Check page identity: filenames alone do not prove the match.
Confirm {count} link(s) based only on natural filename order? Check the images and XML files: these pairs are not proven.

Here you can align witness texts visually, two at a time, using one manuscript as the pivot. When the pivot is aligned with several witnesses, their correspondences can be compared through the pivot.
Review resources and correspondences, then export to Varians. The consistency check never changes your project.
No missing or outdated line references detected.

Read-only check: examines resources and reading order, ignored lines, correspondences (including conflicting anchors), outdated TEI links and whether pivot references can be exported. It never repairs anything automatically.

Open the page manager: inspect images, correct their order, associate ALTO/PAGE files individually and review proposed associations.

Compare TEI edition lines to the selected physical scope and inspect their images before confirming the mapping.
Open the visual line-alignment interface for the pivot and a secondary witness.
Prepare a project folder with project.xml, a copy of the pivot TEI, witnesses and alignment JSON files. Verify compatibility with your installed Varians version.
No TEI edition is attached to the pivot witness: the Varians project will receive an empty TEI edition, as with “Start a new transcription” in Varians.
To prepare the pivot witness’s <pb/> and <lb/> in it: in Varians, File menu → “Project settings…”, check “Prepare pivot-witness <pb/> markers in an empty TEI”.
The export uses the known Varians project.xml format and references your images and ALTO/PAGE sources. External paths may require updating on another computer. Continue?
